reserves.name: Bridge USD reserve envelope (cash, on-chain stablecoins, short-dated Treasuries, Treasury repos, and government MMFs)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: United States Treasury, Bridge-approved stablecoin issuers, and permitted reserve counterparties

reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-07-28: Bridge reserve-management docs still state issued stablecoins are at least 100% collateralized with equivalent fiat value and allocate across on-demand liquid assets (fiat/stablecoins) and Treasuries, naming Lead Bank, BlackRock, Fidelity, Superstate USTB, and BUIDL as partners. Bridge FAQ independently states 1:1 USD backing via short-dated US Treasuries, overnight Treasury repos, money market funds, and cash held in segregated accounts for token holders and custodied by BlackRock and Fidelity. No public USDsui-specific reserve report, independent assurance artifact, or authenticated reserve-API output identifies current weights or holdings, so the complete basket remains one aggregate slice with knownUnknownExposurePct=100.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Bridge Open Issuance reserve categories; USDsui-specific component weights are undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve categories are identified, but USDsui-specific weights, stablecoin identities, and individual bank, repo, and money-market-fund counterparties are not published.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Bridge USD reserve envelope (cash, on-chain stablecoins, short-dated Treasuries, Treasury repos, and government MMFs)
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Bridge publishes the permitted reserve categories but not the current USDsui allocation among them.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Bridge identifies Lead Bank for liquid reserves, BlackRock and Fidelity as custody partners, and segregated bankruptcy-remote accounts, but does not publish USDsui-specific provider allocations or rehypothecation terms.
